about: Phase 4D answer-generation configuration (D6), selected on the v2 dev set, the v1 dev set and the v2 held-out set (which after Phase 4C is DIAGNOSTIC data, not a final benchmark), from experiments D0-D6v (reports/phase4d/experiments; self-assessed blind judgments in reports/phase4d/blind_judgments.json) and frozen BEFORE the v3 held-out run. Claim verification is implemented but OFF (no net benefit measured; +~3 s). The Phase 4C configuration is kept in rag_answer_config_phase4c.json. backend/answer.py DEFAULTS and backend/conversations.py DEFAULTS must equal these values (tests/test_answer_config.py).
passage_select_options: backend/evidence.py DEFAULTS (unchanged from the first measurement; not tuned)
